app.title: Implementation of GPT-2 in pure CMake
app.author: porridgeraisin
app.description: A pure CMake implementation of the GPT-2 transformer model, enabling native C/C++ builds without external dependencies.
proposed_tests: mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. && cmake --build .
Run the built executable with a sample prompt and capture output
Verify that the output contains plausible GPT-2 style text and measure inference time
Compare output length and tokenization against reference implementation
